param: β Constant transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact). Paper suggests range 0 ≤ β ≤ 1.25.
σ Daily rate of transition through exposed compartments.
γ Daily rate of transition through infectious compartments.
π Initial susceptibility; proportion of the population that is susceptible at the start of the epidemic.
N Total population size for the 2014/15 season.
R₀ Basic reproduction number, for an SE₂I₂R model.
Rₙ Effective reproduction number in a partially immune population.
I₀ Initial number of infectious individuals.
TAR Total Attack Rate; the probability of being infected over the whole epidemic for a susceptible individual.
λ₀ Initial infection rate (used in EGR re-parametrization for estimation).
ψ Exponential growth rate (used in EGR re-parametrization for estimation).
p_ICU Probability of ICU admission given infection. Part of the observational model.
μ_ICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU admission. Part of the observational model.
σ²_ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU admission. Part of the observational model.
η Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observation model.
